title: FortuneRAG: Serverless RAG Chatbot for Financial Analysis
summary: A fully serverless retrieval-augmented generation pipeline on AWS that answers financial questions from live SEC filings with citation-backed responses.
bullets: Architected a serverless RAG pipeline on AWS Bedrock, Claude-Sonnet, Lambda, and API Gateway for real-time financial Q&A
Orchestrated automated ETL with AWS Step Functions and Glue, building a Bronze/Silver/Gold data pipeline in Amazon S3
Engineered 7 Python Lambda functions and 3 REST API Gateway endpoints, fully integrated with a Streamlit web front-end
Implemented semantic retrieval using vector embeddings on chunked live SEC filings for grounded, citation-backed LLM answers

title: Customer Behavior Analytics Dashboard
summary: An end-to-end Power BI dashboard turning raw transactional data into segmentation, revenue, and subscription-trend reporting.
bullets: Built an end-to-end customer analytics dashboard by cleaning, transforming, and modeling transactional data using Power Query and DAX to support interactive business reporting

Implemented KPI metrics, cross-filtering, and interactive dashboards to analyze customer segmentation, purchasing behavior, revenue, sales performance, and subscription trends, enabling data-driven decision-making

title: Live Weather and Air Quality Analytics Platform
summary: Hourly weather and air-quality APIs for 8 cities across 4 countries, landed through a four-layer S3 lake and surfaced in a five-page Power BI report — with 64 API runs and 88 data-quality checks passing at 100%.
bullets: Built an end-to-end AWS analytics platform ingesting hourly weather and air quality API data for 8 global cities, transforming raw JSON into curated Parquet datasets across 4 S3 data lake layers
Created Glue catalog tables, 6 Athena reporting views, and a 5-page Power BI report: Overview, Weather Trends, Air Quality Analysis, City Comparison, and Pipeline & Data Quality
Surfaced air-quality benchmarks across the fleet — average AQI 55.26, peak 166, and 30.8K high-pollution hours — with Bengaluru worst at 89.28 AQI against London's 29.52
Instrumented the pipeline itself: 64 API runs and 88 data-quality checks tracked in-report, both holding a 100% pass rate with zero failed runs
Added city and country slicers so temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation, PM2.5 and PM10 can be compared side by side

title: Fashion Product Image Generation Using Diffusion Models
summary: A text-to-image pipeline for fashion products, tuned across 54+ runs and benchmarked with CLIP, FID, and Inception Score.
bullets: Built an end-to-end text-to-image pipeline by cleaning 4k+ fashion samples for Stable Diffusion model training and testing
Performed 54+ tuning runs adjusting guidance, steps & schedulers to enhance prompt-image alignment and output quality
Applied CLIP, FID & Inception Score to evaluate images and identified Euler with guidance=9, steps=50 as optimal config
Benchmarked Stable Diffusion v1.5 vs Kandinsky 2.2 using CLIP scores & statistical tests to compare accuracy and stability

title: Intelligent Financial Reporting Agent
summary: A conversational analytics layer over a Microsoft Fabric warehouse, combining GPT-4 RAG with Vanna AI text-to-SQL to cut reporting time by 60%.
bullets: Architected a unified financial data warehouse on Microsoft Fabric OneLake to centralize diverse multi-source wealth data
Implemented RAG-based GPT-4 pipelines to enable contextual, conversational financial analytics for portfolio performance
Integrated Vanna AI text-to-SQL for natural-language querying, reducing manual financial reporting and analysis time by 60%
Delivered an interactive insights dashboard offering real-time trends and comprehensive data-driven investment intelligence

title: Walmart Sales Forecasting and Demand Analytics
summary: Weekly store-level demand forecasting across 45 regions, benchmarking Silverkite against Neural Prophet and shipped behind a Flask service.
bullets: Performed EDA and preprocessing on Walmart sales data using pandas and seaborn to identify trends, seasonality, and outliers
Engineered temporal features and applied Greykite and Neural Prophet models to forecast weekly store sales across 45 regions
Assessed Silverkite and Neural Prophet models using RMSE and MAPE metrics, improving forecasting accuracy and reliability
Built an ML pipeline in Python for data loading, training, and Flask deployment, ensuring reusable and scalable forecasting

title: California Wildfires Prediction & Analysis
summary: Seven years of wildfire records joined to weather APIs, modeled with logistic regression and visualized county-by-county in Tableau.
bullets: Built logistic regression model predicting California wildfires with 71% accuracy using Python and Pandas on 1,636+ fires
Analyzed weather-fire correlations using PostgreSQL, identifying peak wildfire months through statistical analysis
Engineered ETL pipeline processing 7 years of wildfire data, integrating weather APIs for feature enrichment
Designed Tableau dashboards visualizing 4,000+ acres burned across counties, driving data-driven wildfire insights

title: Amazon Prime Movies & TV Shows Analytics Dashboard
summary: 9,655 Prime Video titles modeled in Power Query and DAX into a catalog explorer — growth across 1920–2021, the 80/20 Movie-to-TV mix, 519 genres, content ratings, and title origin by country.
bullets: Transformed and modeled 9,655 Amazon Prime Movies & TV Shows records in Power Query and DAX into an analytics-ready dataset
Charted catalog growth as an area chart of titles by release year across a 1920–2021 span, broken out by Movie versus TV Show, with a donut showing the 80.8% / 19.2% split
Ranked the catalog by genre — Drama 986, Comedy 536, Drama/Suspense 399 — and by content rating, and mapped where titles originate on a world map
Summarised the catalog in KPI cards covering 9,655 titles, 25 content ratings, 519 distinct genres, 5,771 distinct directors, and a 1920–2021 release-year range
Designed the report on a custom dark theme branded with the Prime Video logo, with slicers and drill-through for exploration

title: EEG Seizure Detection Using Deep Learning
summary: A CNN-RNN hybrid trained on over a million EEG signals from CHB-MIT and Bonn, built as an early-alert prototype for neurologists.
bullets: Preprocessed 1M+ EEG signals from CHB-MIT and Bonn datasets to extract temporal and spectral features for seizure analysis
Developed CNN-RNN hybrid model in Python/TensorFlow, achieving strong accuracy across cross-validated seizure detection
Designed experimental pipeline with cross-validation and error analysis to compare models and improve generalisation
Delivered prototype enabling early seizure alerts, supporting neurologist decision-making and real-time monitoring

title: Airport Performance Optimization
summary: A million analytical flights measured against an 85% on-time SLA — the airport lands at 80.89%, a 4.11-point miss, with no carrier in the fleet clearing the bar.
bullets: Designed a hybrid MySQL and MongoDB schema with UML and EER modelling, loaded by a Python ETL over roughly a million analytical flights
Scored on-time performance against an 85% SLA target in Power BI: 80.89% actual, a 4.11-point gap, flagged Non-Compliant against a progress-to-target gauge
Split every scheduled flight by disposition — 824K on time (78.88%), 195K delayed (18.64%), 24K cancelled (2.27%) and 2K diverted (0.21%)
Ranked on-time performance by carrier and surfaced that not one of them meets the target, from Alaska at the top to PSA Airlines at the bottom
Attributed delay hours by cause — previous flight late 39.29%, airline operations 32.26%, air traffic control 21.16% — and ranked the ten busiest airports by average minutes late, led by Detroit
Added airline and date-range slicers plus a day-of-week view, exposing Tuesday as the strongest day and Thursday the weakest

title: AI/ML Mental Health Chatbot (SAAC)
summary: An NLP support chatbot with voice and text input, built for accessibility and continuity of care rather than one-off answers.
bullets: Engineered an NLP-based mental health chatbot (SAAC) using Keras and TensorFlow, offering 24/7 personalized support
Crafted a user-friendly interface with text and voice input via Web Speech API, enhancing accessibility
Achieved 92% accuracy in intent classification, ensuring precise user interactions and effective mental health support
Enabled chat history tracking, improving follow-up care and continuous user engagement

title: Real-Time 3D Human Pose Estimation for Ergonomics
summary: Live posture monitoring with YOLOv8x-pose and MediaPipe that flags text-neck and misalignment before it becomes a musculoskeletal problem.
bullets: Built 3D posture estimation system using YOLOv8x-pose & MediaPipe, achieving 91.2% mAP for ergonomic monitoring
Processed 500K+ kinematic keypoints to classify posture deviations and detect poor ergonomic alignment across frames
Integrated live on-screen posture alerts to notify users during prolonged misalignment, reducing ergonomic strain risk
Enhanced workplace health compliance by enabling real-time correction for text-neck and musculoskeletal disorder prevention

title: Data Science Job Salaries Dashboard
summary: A Tableau explorer over global data-science compensation — salary by experience level, job title, company size and country, filterable by location and role.
bullets: Built a Tableau dashboard over a global data-science salary dataset, cross-filterable by company location and job title
Ranked average salary by job title down to the experience-level split — Principal Data Engineer topping out at $600,000, Research Scientist at $450,000, and ML Engineer at $270,000
Profiled the market by company size (61.4% medium, 29.9% large, 8.7% small) and by seniority (61.4% senior, 25.4% intermediate, 8.7% entry level)
Mapped average salary by country on a Mapbox layer spanning $9,272 to $87,852, alongside a top-10 employee-residence ranking led by the US
Surfaced employment mix at a glance: 97.5% full-time against 0.9% freelance and 0.6% part-time

title: Clinical Notes Disease Classification using NLP & Transformers
summary: A multi-model NLP framework that reads unstructured clinical narratives and classifies them into 10 diseases — from TF–IDF and XGBoost through to BioClinicalBERT, with XGBoost reaching 98.12% test accuracy.
bullets: Built an NLP pipeline classifying diseases from 18,885 clinical notes across 10 classes, drawn from the 160,000-note AGBonnet Augmented Clinical Notes corpus

Engineered preprocessing with negation detection (“no history of…”, “denies…”) and medical abbreviation expansion (htn → hypertension, dm → diabetes mellitus, cad → coronary artery disease) to reduce mislabeling
Trained and benchmarked 10+ models from Logistic Regression to BioClinicalBERT; XGBoost with early stopping took first place at 98.12% accuracy, ahead of a stacking classifier at 98.09%
Engineered TF–IDF features (uni + bi-gram, 30K max) for classical ML and sequence-encoding pipelines at length 256 feeding CNN, LSTM and BiLSTM models
Applied a stratified 70/10/20 split and weighted metrics to handle severe class imbalance — cancer alone accounts for 7,402 of the notes against 50–700 for the smallest classes
